trips.route_note: Take the Mitre commuter train from Retiro station to the Tigre terminus, about 1 hour; from the station it is a short walk to the riverfront Puerto de Frutos and the boat docks for delta cruises.

trips.why: The Mitre commuter train from Retiro takes about 1h 7m and drops you a short walk from the riverfront Puerto de Frutos and the delta cruise docks.
know: The bus is slower at about 1h 33m, so the train is the better choice.
Check the Mitre timetable before you go, since daily frequency isn't listed here.
Delta boat cruises leave from the docks near the station.
